name: Space Attracts
description: Space Attracts is an online jump adventure game that challenges your skills and reflexes. With NapTech Games, you can enjoy this game for hours on end. Space Attracts Online Jump Adventure Games is a game created by NapTech Games. It is an online game that can be played by multiple people at the same time. The goal of the game is to reach the highest score by jumping on different platforms and avoiding obstacles.
